messages:
Carla: quick check — vendor said ~48 A100 slots arriving for apac-demo pool but timeline fuzzy. We need a canary: 8 nodes (4xA100 per node) starting Tue. Can we do a temporal slice allocation (staggered canary + soak) if full quota isn't available? ping @ben @mike. ticket #4281
Ben: I don't see 48 reflected in our quota dashboard. Last sync showed 24 hard + 24 pending. I asked vendor-liaison to confirm exact manifest and ETA. If it's 24 hard we should plan a staggered rollout.
vendor-liaison: Vendor: confirmed manifest -> 24 guaranteed A100s (ETA ~2025-01-18), remaining 24 on contingent manifest w/ ETA open. Will escalate to try for earlier serials; can confirm within 48h.
Mike: ok — operationally we can do temporal slicing: week1 canary 2 nodes (8 GPUs), week2 soak + another 2 nodes, then expand. That keeps canary small and gives time for serials. If vendor can't deliver, we can mix in H100 reserved slots for the soak to hit throughput. :thinking_face:
Priya: finance note — burst demo budget covers up to 24 GPUs for 4 weeks. If we keep >24 for >1 month we need reserved pricing approval. I started a PO draft (https://concourse.internal/po/867).
Ben: created a minimal terraform change for the canary carve, CI will run smoke tests. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/980 (small snippet below)
Ben: ```
resource "rw_gpu_pool" "apac-demo-canary" {
  gpu_type = "a100-80gb"
  count = 2
  purpose = "canary-apac-demo"
}
```
infra-bot: reservation #rv-2025-94 created for rw_gpu_pool.apac-demo-canary (2 nodes) — will auto-expire in 14d unless promoted. :robot_face:
Carla: ok that covers the immediate canary. Ben — once vendor confirms the second tranche, can you update the PR to include the staged expansion? mike/priya we good with mixing H100 if needed?
Mike: yep good with mix, will prep fallback runbook (short steps + perf checks).
Priya: finance acked provisional reserved pricing approval if we move to >24 for 6+ weeks. I'll post final after PO updates.
Ben: noted — will patch PR for staged expansion once vendor update lands. tagging vendor-liaison for the 48h confirm.
vendor-liaison: will follow up in ~36h with serial numbers and whether we can split shipment.
Carla: thanks all — I'll leave ticket #4281 in "awaiting vendor" until vendor-liaison posts update. :thumbsup:
